thread:
emily (Design): quick design question — in request drilldown the error-context tooltip feels dense. thinking we should split the CTA for export out of the inline tooltip and move it to the header toolbar. thoughts?

raj (Product): agree on moving CTA out, it's noisy in tooltip. but we still want an affordance to export the exact view (filters + time range). maybe a small '⋯' menu inside the tooltip that has 'Export view' so power users can still act quickly.

emily (Design): @raj yeah — header-level primary action could be 'Export trace' and tooltip can keep a tiny link 'Copy request id' / 'Open full trace' only. prefer explicit wording over 'Download snapshot'.

maria (Eng): implementation note: exporting from header means we need to capture current filter state server-side. doable but adds ~200ms extra work on export job. not huge but FYI for perf.

liam (A11y): a11y nit — whichever control we surface must be keyboard reachable and have an aria-label that includes the request id for context, e.g. `Export trace (request: 89a4f2)`. Also ensure focus trap doesn't break when we open export modal.

emily (Design): good call. draft tooltip copy to replace current long paragraph:

```
Error context — top frames and request metadata. Click to expand stack and copy request id.
```

And CTA in header: `Export trace` + chevron menu for file type.

raj (Product): language suggestions: prefer "Export trace" over "Export snapshot". "Snapshot" is ambiguous. Also add microcopy under export: "Includes filters, time range, and visible stack frames".

maria (Eng): for file types let's default to JSON (trace + metadata) and provide HAR as opt-in. backend will attach a small metadata blob with model of error. ok?

emily (Design): layout question — do we place Export button on the left (next to Back) or right (near filters)? my instinct: right, grouped with filters and time range. keeps action locality consistent.

liam (A11y): right is better for scan order but ensure it appears before the overflow menu in DOM order for keyboard users. also reduced contrast icons need check — export button must meet 4.5:1 with bg.

raj (Product): +1 to right. also propose keyboard shortcut `E` to open export modal. shortcut listed in command palette.

maria (Eng): mapping `E` is fine but avoid single-letter global conflicts — maybe `Shift+E`? we'll check conflicts.

emily (Design): mock updated: placed Export on right, primary outline button, tooltip slimmed, added small link copy id inside tooltip. I'll push screens in Figma and tag you all.

ui-bot: deploy-preview for the new export modal is up at https://ui-stage.redwood.ai/trace-export-170012 — contains keyboard shortcut demo and export JSON.

raj (Product): I'll update copy in the product copy doc to "Export trace" + the microcopy line and record the reasoning. thanks all — can we sync tomorrow 10am for quick sign-off?

emily (Design): works for me.

maria (Eng): works.

liam (A11y): works. I'll bring a11y checklist. :thumbsup:
